newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's KamAZ to sign share swap papers soon.
newsitem.headline: Russia's KamAZ to sign share swap papers soon.

text.p: Russian truckmaker AO KamAZ will sign a debt-equity swap agreement with the government of the autonomous Tatarstan republic next month, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
In January KamAZ shareholders' meeting approved a swap of up to 40 percent of shares in return for Tatarstan government guarantees to pay KamAZ's debt, Nail Galiullin told Reuters.
"Most likely, the the documents will be signed in June," he said.
The shares have already been issued and were created especially for the swap.

KamAZ's debt amounts to 1.44 trillion roubles, including credits from the federal government to rebuild its main factory after a devastating fire in 1993 and a $100 million credit from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
Tatarstan already owns eight percent of KamAZ, which is based in Tatarstan where it is a major employer.
